mapper.select: SELECT id, status, attempts, total_attempts, replay_generation, claim_token, lease_until, last_error FROM outbox_event WHERE id = #{eventId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 'PENDING', attempts = 0, replay_generation = replay_generation + 1, next_attempt_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), last_error = NULL, sent_at = NULL WHERE id = #{eventId} AND status = 'DEAD' AND replay_generation = #{expectedGeneration} AND claim_token IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_replay_audit (request_id, event_id, operator_id, expected_generation, accepted_generation, reason, previous_attempts, total_attempts_snapshot, previous_error) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{eventId}, #{operatorId}, #{expectedGeneration}, #{acceptedGeneration}, #{reason}, #{previousAttempts}, #{totalAttemptsSnapshot}, #{previousError})
